findings.message: Supplier GSTIN "29AAECS1234F1Z" is not a valid 15-character GSTIN.
findings.fix: Copy the GSTIN from the GST portal certificate; do not type it by hand.

findings.message: Line 1 charges CGST/SGST for an inter-state supply (supplier 29 → recipient 27).
findings.fix: Inter-state supply is charged IGST only.

findings.message: Invoice total 120000 does not match the computed 67325.
findings.fix: Recompute: taxable + tax + charges − discount + round-off.

findings.message: Aggregate annual turnover is ₹6,00,00,000, so this B2B supply needs an IRN on the IRP portal.
findings.fix: Generate the IRN and QR, then print IRN, ACK number, ACK date and the QR on the invoice.

findings.message: Line 1 code "0901" has 4 digits; 6 digits are required (AATO above ₹5 crore).
findings.fix: Extend the code to the digit depth your turnover band requires.
Recompute the tax from the taxable value and the rate.
Line total must equal taxable value plus tax.

findings.message: Stated taxable value 57000 does not match the sum of lines 57500.
findings.fix: Reconcile the line totals against the invoice total.
Print the total invoice value in words.

findings.message: Supplier phone or email is missing.
findings.fix: Print a contact so the buyer can reconcile a query.

findings.message: Line 1 charges 18% GST on 0901 (Coffee, tea, mate and spices); this heading is commonly 5%.
findings.fix: Verify the rate on the GST portal rate finder for your exact product. A wrong rate is a bigger risk than a missing HSN.

findings.message: Goods supply of ₹120000 exceeds the ₹50,000 e-way bill threshold. State-specific thresholds may differ.
findings.fix: Generate the e-way bill for the consignment and record its number on the invoice; confirm your state threshold.
Round-off should be a rounding of a few paise, not a discount.

findings.message: No payment terms or payment mode is stated.
findings.fix: State the payment mode and due date; it decides when tax is due.
